bannerText: Orbit Poster: bài đã điền sẵn nguyên văn. Bấm Post trên OKX để đăng, rồi báo Muse là xong.
note: v2.11: the OKX leg pasted into the INLINE "Bạn đang nghĩ gì?" / "Share your thoughts" box instead of opening the composer panel, the same class of bug the Square leg had before v2.7/v2.8/v2.9. The OKX leg now opens the composer panel first (Post/Create button, or clicking the inline box itself), fills text and image into the PANEL field via dialog-aware findField/attachImage, waits for the image preview inside the dialog before clicking Post (up to 10s), retries the Post click up to 3 times with a fuller mouse event sequence, and re-checks for a reopened draft before reporting POSTED (mirrors Square v2.8/v2.9/v2.10). waitAfterImage raised 1200 to 3000ms. If no panel opens, it falls back to the inline box instead of failing.
squareBannerText: Orbit Poster: bài Square đã điền sẵn nguyên văn. Bấm Post trên Binance để đăng, rồi báo Muse là xong.
